_doc: T032 LEGAL gov-oracle (TT-478 / TT-717). Pennsylvania inheritance tax charge (72 P.S. § 9116(a)), beneficiary-side (rate keyed to the beneficiary's relationship). Each case asserts the Catala-computed tax equals the AUTHORITATIVE figure live-sourced from revenue.pa.gov on `sourced_at` — never from memory. scripts/oracle_verify.py runs PaInheritanceTaxCharge.Charge with `inputs` and requires the Computed-arm money to equal `expected_money` (USD). There is no threshold — PA tax is charged from the first dollar. NeedsHuman cases (deduction_or_exemption_claimed) are covered by the standard's own *.test-fixtures.json, not here.
statute: 72 P.S. § 9116(a) — Pennsylvania inheritance tax rates by relationship (0% spouse / parent-from-child-≤21; 4.5% lineal; 12% sibling; 15% collateral)

cases.label: lineal-100k
cases.citation_quote: 4.5 percent on transfers to direct descendants and lineal heirs;

cases.label: sibling-100k
cases.citation_quote: 12 percent on transfers to siblings; and

cases.label: collateral-100k
cases.citation_quote: 15 percent on transfers to other heirs, except charitable organizations, exempt institutions and government entities exempt from tax.

cases.label: surviving-spouse-exempt
cases.citation_quote: 0 percent on transfers to a surviving spouse or to a parent from a child aged 21 or younger;
cases.note: 0% structural exemption for a surviving spouse (not a zero-valued rate).

cases.label: child-under-21-to-parent-exempt
cases.citation_quote: 0 percent on transfers to a surviving spouse or to a parent from a child aged 21 or younger;
cases.note: 0% on a transfer to a parent from a child aged 21 or younger.

cases.label: exempt-charity-or-government
cases.citation_quote: 15 percent on transfers to other heirs, except charitable organizations, exempt institutions and government entities exempt from tax.
cases.note: Charitable organisations / exempt institutions / government entities are exempt (Computed $0).
